name: wire-tlv-37-sizes-that-load
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key lat float deg
key lon float deg
key hae float m
key course float deg
key callsign string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key n int -
key x int -
key y int -
key a float -
key s1 string -
key s2 string -
key label string -
key qty int -
list items "a list"
list subs "a nested list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.13.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire tlv
field probe.n 4:8 twos
field course 21:4 f32
field probe.a 20:8 f64
field probe.x 5:1 uint
field hae 15:2 uscale:19900/65535:-900
field uid 3 utf8
field probe.s2 22 hex
